Thank you for wanting to help. **Fillsign doesn't accept outside contributions yet** ([CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)): its ownership and licensing are still being set up, and accepting code now would complicate that. This pull request will be closed without its code being read.

To report a problem or suggest a change, please [open an issue](https://github.com/fillsign/fillsign/issues/new/choose) instead.
